title.en: Google publishes an introduction to its latest AI threat report
title.zhHans: Google 发布最新 AI 威胁报告导读

searchSummary.en: Google published an official introduction to its AI threat-tracking report on November 16, linking the full report, which describes GTIG and Mandiant observations of agentic attack-tool use.
searchSummary.zhHans: Google 于十一月十六日发布其 AI 威胁追踪报告的官方导读，链接完整报告；该报告描述 GTIG 与 Mandiant 所观察到的智能体攻击工具使用情况。

narrative.en: The action is dated by the November 16 official introduction, not a verified exact first-online UTC timestamp. The full report page is dated November 17. This difference is preserved, not split into two report releases. Observations are GTIG/Mandiant telemetry claims, not an industry-wide rate or independent audit.

text.en: Google published an official introduction to its AI threat-tracking report on November 16, linking the full report, which describes GTIG and Mandiant observations of agentic attack-tool use.
